subject.title: fix(anthropic): add claude-fable-5 to CLI allowlist, aliases, labels, and context window

question: Is the current models-list/module-level proof enough for this Claude CLI model-routing change, or should merge wait for real configure, model-picker, or Claude CLI selection proof?
rationale: The patch is narrow and source-supported, but this read-only review cannot exercise the subscription-backed Claude CLI selection path and repository policy treats provider routing plus session context behavior as proof-sensitive.

options.title: Require real CLI proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a terminal screenshot from the latest head showing configure/model-picker output or actual Claude CLI selection with Fable 5 before merge.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the models-list/module-level evidence and own the risk that the subscription-backed Claude CLI path was not exercised.

options.title: Reconcile resolver overlap
options.body: If this PR lands, close or retarget the overlapping resolver PR so duplicate context-window changes do not stay open.

recommendation.title: Require real CLI proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a terminal screenshot from the latest head showing configure/model-picker output or actual Claude CLI selection with Fable 5 before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history signal on the Fable 5 model contract and adjacent Claude CLI runtime support.
